/* 로그인 이력관리 (7021) */ /* AdminLogLoginMapper.selectList */
SELECT AI_INPT_LGIN_HST_NO, AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_NO, AI_INPT_LGIN_USG_IPAD, AI_INPT_LGIN_YN, AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_MCHR_NM, TRN_LOG_SRNO, LST_DB_CHG_ID, LST_DB_CHG_DTM, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(AI_INPT_LGIN_DTM,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AI_INPT_LGIN_DTM, NVL((SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_NO AND ROWNUM = 1),AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_NO) AS AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_NM FROM CSPD810TH A WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_DTM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_DTM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_USG_IPAD
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_USG_IPAD DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_MCHR_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_USER_MCHR_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_YN
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_YN DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_LGIN_DTM DESC

if.test: schSdate1 != null and schSdate1 != '' and schEdate1 != null and schEdate1 != ''

sql.if: AND SUBSTR(AI_INPT_LGIN_DTM,1,8) BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','')
